name: Intuit QuickBooks
description:
QuickBooks turns your business's financial data into clear, decision-ready insights, and now takes action on it too. Analyze profitability, cash flow, and balance sheet health, and benchmark your performance against similar businesses in your industry and region. See who owes you money and which bills are coming due with A/R and A/P aging, and break down sales by customer or product to find what is driving revenue. Create, update, send, duplicate, and schedule invoices and estimates. Add customers and products, generate, and send payment links and reminders, always with a clear preview and your confirmation before anything is sent. Get fast read-only answers on payroll and QuickBooks Capital. Look up payroll details, and when you need to, add an employee or set base pay. Check your QuickBooks Capital loans and peer lending benchmarks. 

No account yet? Upload CSVs, PDFs, or images, or paste transactions directly, and QuickBooks will sync and analyze your results as your business grows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Intuit QuickBooks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Intuit QuickBooks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-inc.quickbooks.intuit.com/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Intuit QuickBooks MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Intuit QuickBooks scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Intuit QuickBooks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit QuickBooks lists 71 MCP tools, including profit-loss-generator, cash-flow-generator, benchmarking-against-industry, profit-loss-quickbooks-account, cash-flow-quickbooks-account, benchmarking-quickbooks-account, company-info, quickbooks-transaction-import, quickbooks-import-status, quickbooks-profile-info-update, industry-recommendation, and qbo_accounting_get_balance_sheet.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Intuit QuickBooks in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Intuit QuickBooks MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit QuickBooks does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
